headline_application_PSS_all_phases.missing_rule: No eligible sample means unobserved, never zero. No three-run range exists in a single block.
headline_application_PSS_all_phases.scope: Per-run sampled application-tree maximum over all independently eligible complete/stable/same-phase observations; not full-resident memory requirement or atomic peak.
headline_application_PSS_all_phases.tie_rule: First eligible raw observation among tied maxima; scan_end is a non-atomic scan endpoint.

prior_failed_reference_only.scope: Reference only; preserve this capsule once in the final aggregate, with older diagnostics nested. No old app enters new measurements.

platform.scope: Exact fresh root API UID/PVC/image binding plus local mount, resource, idle GPU and owned-file probes. Sampled admission, no capacity reservation, continuous health, exclusive cores or bandwidth claim.

scope: Only one complete prospective8-app block; no global24 success before three independently complete blocks. Raw parent/checkpoint/shutdown clocks and within-block ratios are rederived; serialized consumed-input digests are source-bound equality evidence, not independently rehashed tensor bytes. Source-reported hashing cost is bounded, not re-timed. Every raw CPU bracket/mask/boundary and recorded disk threshold is checked; raw statvfs block multiplication was not serialized. PSS eligibility/maxima retain every eligible phase and explicit unknowns, with no CPU/disk filtering. No recorded path/graph/model access, producer import, new experiment, live cluster/YT check, population/cross-allocation causal claim.

latest_inventory.scope: Non-atomic sampled output-byte cap, not an instantaneous quota; vanished entries are skipped and counted, observed bytes are never subtracted.

raw_disk_and_latest_inventory.scope: Each recorded available-byte/inode/readonly/device threshold and latest sampled inventory checked. Byte availability was derived by pinned statvfs code; raw block components were not serialized. Initial40GiB/positive exposed inodes admission is separate from runtime4GiB/positive exposed inodes. No instantaneous quota, capacity reservation, node eviction or continuous-health guarantee.

storage_block.scope: Original dynamic root proof and recorded disk rows; no recorded path opened. Root API identity is root-attested. Raw statvfs block arithmetic was not serialized; no capacity reservation or continuous/global health claim.
